products.title: Fleece Vest - Timber Brown/Jet Black
products.body_html:
Built for warmth without unnecessary bulk, the Fleece Vest combines a recycled fleece body with durable woven overlays for a versatile layer designed for the course and beyond. The 250 GSM 100% recycled polyester knit fleece provides soft, comfortable warmth, while strategically placed 94% nylon / 6% spandex woven overlays add durability, structure, and stretch in high-use areas.

The full-zip silhouette features a stand collar for added coverage, zippered hand pockets, and a functional chest pocket for secure storage. The combination of fleece and lightweight woven fabric gives the vest a technical, multi-textured look while maintaining the comfort and mobility needed for everyday layering.
